knowledge.plain_language_summary: Face-lit trimless pan letters with milled-shoulder acrylic faces, mounted on a square-tube wireway with remote power, used for canopy and secondary wall identification.
knowledge.rationale: Trimless milled-shoulder acrylic is a premium clean-face detail; wireway mounting consolidates wiring and keeps supplies remote.

structure.construction: 2in deep pan letters, 0.063in aluminum returns/backs welded, 1/2in translucent white acrylic faces with milled mounting shoulders, logo face translucent vinyl, remote power
2x2in aluminum square-tube wireway with endcaps and fabricated brackets

craft_observations: Trimless milled-shoulder acrylic = premium seamless face.
Remote supplies keep the letters shallow and clean.
